name: DR Congo
people: Where Congolese and Co-designers design the nation they want to live in.
codesigner: Everyone who shares a vision, a voice or an enterprise here becomes a Co-designer of Perfect DR Congo: one of a community of selfless people, at home and abroad, building a nation where every citizen has a decent life.

paras: You mined 230,000 tonnes of cobalt in 2025, about three of every four tonnes on Earth, and you hold half the world’s known reserves. … The batteries of the energy transition begin in your ground. Most of you still have no electricity at all.
letter.quote: “The batteries of the energy transition begin in your ground. Let the first thing they power be a classroom with the lights on.”

mandates.terms: For the Government of DR Congo, its development partners and investors. Scope and fees are agreed in writing before any work begins.

capita.pc_text: The yearly cost, per person, of lifting everyone above the Living Line in all seven basic living standards, set with DR Congo in its own prices.
capita.price_text: Perfect Capita times the population: the national bill, each year.
capita.est: Perfect Nations estimate, to be confirmed with DR Congo. The learning and livelihood figures are more than five years old and are marked as dated.
capita.measures: Strict measures. Food: share not moderately or severely food insecure (FAO). Water: safely managed drinking water where measured; where it is not, basic water, marked as such. Shelter: the lower of safely managed sanitation and the share outside urban slums. Energy: the lower of electricity per person against 1,000 kWh and clean cooking. Education: the lower of children reading by the end of primary school and lower-secondary completion. Health: WHO service coverage index. Livelihood: share above the stricter of the national poverty line and the World Bank line for the nation’s income group. Each figure links to its source.

voices.local: We are looking for the people with real stories from DR Congo: the leaders who built something that works, and the keepers of local knowledge who know how their communities live, cope and thrive.

close_lead: Share your vision, suggest a guest, or write to us. Every message receives a personal reply.
